## `browser.console.method` values

`browser.console.method` has the following list of well-known values. If one of them applies, then the respective value MUST be used; otherwise, a custom value MAY be used.

| Value | Stability | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `debug` | development | `console.debug` was called. |
| `error` | development | `console.error` was called. |
| `info` | development | `console.info` was called. |
| `log` | development | `console.log` was called. |
| `warn` | development | `console.warn` was called. |

## `browser.navigation.type` values

`browser.navigation.type` has the following list of well-known values. If one of them applies, then the respective value MUST be used; otherwise, a custom value MAY be used.

| Value | Stability | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `push` | development | A new entry was added to the history, e.g. by `history.pushState()`. |
| `reload` | development | The current history entry was reloaded. |
| `replace` | development | The current history entry was replaced, e.g. by `history.replaceState()`. |
| `traverse` | development | An existing history entry was navigated to, e.g. by the back or forward button. |

## `browser.navigation_timing.type` values

`browser.navigation_timing.type` has the following list of well-known values. If one of them applies, then the respective value MUST be used; otherwise, a custom value MAY be used.

| Value | Stability | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `back_forward` | development | Navigation through the browser's history traversal, e.g. the back or forward button. |
| `navigate` | development | Navigation started by clicking a link, entering a URL, a form submission, or a script operation. |
| `prerender` | development | Navigation to a page that was prerendered. |
| `reload` | development | Navigation through a reload operation or a `Location.reload()` call. |

## `browser.resource_timing.render_blocking_status` values

`browser.resource_timing.render_blocking_status` has the following list of well-known values. If one of them applies, then the respective value MUST be used; otherwise, a custom value MAY be used.

| Value | Stability | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `blocking` | development | The resource blocked rendering. |
| `non-blocking` | development | The resource did not block rendering. |

## Notes

### `browser.navigation.hash_change`

A navigation that removes the fragment is not reported as a hash change, even though only the fragment changed.

### `browser.navigation.same_document`

Soft navigations performed by a single-page application through the History or Navigation API are same-document navigations; the initial page load is not.

### `browser.navigation_timing.unload_event_end`

Zero if there was no previous document, or if the previous document has a different origin.

### `browser.navigation_timing.unload_event_start`

Zero if there was no previous document, or if the previous document has a different origin.

### `browser.resource_timing.next_hop_protocol`

Empty for cross-origin resources that are not served with a `Timing-Allow-Origin` response header field.

### `browser.resource_timing.redirect_end`

Zero if there was no redirect, or if a redirect is not same-origin.

### `browser.resource_timing.redirect_start`

Zero if there was no redirect, or if a redirect is not same-origin.

### `browser.resource_timing.secure_connection_start`

Zero if the resource is not fetched over a secure connection.

### `browser.resource_timing.worker_start`

Zero if the request is not intercepted by a service worker.
